copper mountain.note: Happy Friday! Our snowmaking crews have been working hard to refresh our trails and with a chance of snow flurries throughout the day, we are looking at some great skiing and riding. Today you can expect cloudy skies with temps into the high-20s. Winds will be high around 20-30 mph from the southwest, gusting into the 50s. Stay up-to-date with terrain openings by using the Terrain Alerts Channel on the Copper Mountain Instagram. Our next update on there will be tomorrow with the Easy Rider surface lift and associated terrain. Remember to always ski and ride in control, stay aware of those around you, and respect all posted signs, closures, and ropes. Get out there and enjoy making turns!

snowbird.note: Resort Update: All uphill travel is CLOSED for snowmaking and winter 2026/27 on-mountain preparation. Snowbird is scheduled to open for lift-serviced operations on November 27. Mountain Report: The brief break is over and snow has returned to the canyon, delivering 9 inches since last report and 5 inches overnight. The storm picked back up mid-morning yesterday and continued throughout the day and last night. There's a lot of wind with this event, so don't let the snow stake fool you! If you haven't already, it's time to wax those skis and get those snow tires on your car. We hope to see you at Opening Day on Black Friday, November 27, conditions permitting. While we are all ever-so-patiently waiting to get back on board, join us for Pre-Season Passholder Appreciation Day on November 21. Come build some preseason stoke, pick up your season pass and UDOT sticker (we are 100% back in snow tire season) and get your skis or snowboard waxed by our friends at Board Budder . Passholder Appreciation Day details Then, carbo-load for Opening Day with Thanksgiving at Snowbird . Bring the family, make a reservation and leave the cooking and cleanup to us. And Season Passholders, don't forget about your Early Bird Benefit (Passholder's who bought/renewed by May 13). Your free night at The Cliff Lodge is valid through December 17. The first couple of weekends of ski season are always exciting ones, so get your stay on the books while availability allows. The mountain is white. Snowmaking is underway. Opening Day is getting closer. Give me The Bird
